reviewWhen: NexaTerm median RSS / mXterm median RSS > requirements.idleMemoryReviewRatio
CPU is not near idle or shows unexplained periodic polling

steps: Open ten independent SSH terminal instances against fixture or isolated test hosts.
Create at least one split containing two live SSH instances.
Open SFTP/Remote Files for at least two sessions and list directories.
Run at least one upload and one download while all ten SSH sessions stay connected.
Open Monitoring for one SSH session and collect multiple refreshes.
Type and switch focus across sessions while transfer/monitoring remain active.
Close all terminals, SFTP panels, monitoring, transfers and split panes.
Wait for settleMs and record the same process-tree metrics.
reviewWhen: child processes remain after their owning sessions are closed
RSS or process count grows monotonically across close/reopen cycles without explanation
PTY, tunnel, runner, monitor or transfer workers continue after owners are closed

steps: Force-disconnect one SSH session while nine others remain active.
Fail one transfer and one monitoring refresh.
Verify unrelated sessions and workspace interactions remain usable.
